name: hanzo-ai
description: HIP-0300 unified tool surface for Claude — 13 action-routed tools covering filesystem, execution, code semantics, git, networking, and Hanzo platform.
long_description:
# Hanzo AI Extension

HIP-0300 unified tool surface for Claude, built on the Model Context Protocol (MCP).

## 13 Unified Tools

### Core (7)
- **fs** — read, write, edit, stat, list, mkdir, rm, mv, apply_patch, search_text
- **exec** — run, background, ps, kill, logs
- **code** — parse, search, transform, summarize (AST + LSP)
- **git** — status, diff, log, commit, branch, stash
- **fetch** — get, post, put, delete, download
- **workspace** — info, config, env, dependencies
- **ui** — browse, search and install UI components

### Optional (6)
- **think** — structured reasoning
- **memory** — persistent knowledge storage
- **hanzo** — iam, kms, paas, commerce, storage, auth, api
- **plan** — task planning with step tracking
- **tasks** — task management
- **mode** — development modes

## Authentication

Hanzo IAM (hanzo.id) for cloud features. Anonymous mode available for local-only tools.
